LESSON: DUA (SUPPLICATION WHEN TRAVELLING)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.3: Dua (Supplication when travelling)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Dua (Supplication when travelling). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Dua (Supplication when travelling)
2. Practise Dua (Supplication when travelling) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dua (Supplication when travelling)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Dua (Supplication when travelling)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Dua (Supplication when travelling). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Dua (Supplication when travelling) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Dua (Supplication when travelling) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dua (Supplication when travelling)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Dua (Supplication when travelling). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Dua (Supplication when travelling) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Dua (Supplication when travelling) in the examples.
2. Explain Dua (Supplication when travelling) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dua (Supplication when travelling).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dua (Supplication when travelling) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Dua (Supplication when travelling) important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Dua (Supplication when travelling)
2. Practise Dua (Supplication when travelling) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dua (Supplication when travelling)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
